venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print(f"Page {page_index}: {page}")
    if not page:
        break
    all_friends.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total existing friends: {len(all_friends)}")
